mainEntity.name: What should I do if I get an ATO audit letter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not ignore it. Engage a registered tax agent immediately — at the first letter, not the final demand. The agent manages ATO correspondence, prepares the requested information, and negotiates outcomes. Early engagement keeps the matter contained and reduces escalation risk.

mainEntity.name: Can a tax agent represent me to the ATO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — that is a core right of TPB registration. A registered agent can receive your ATO correspondence, respond to queries, negotiate payment plans, lodge objections, and represent you in disputes. Tell us you need audit or dispute support in the questionnaire.

mainEntity.name: How much does ATO audit help cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on complexity. A simple data-matching query may be a few hundred dollars; a full audit with objections can be several thousand. The matched agent quotes after assessing the scope. The matching service itself is free.

mainEntity.name: Can I dispute an ATO amended assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A registered agent can lodge an objection to an amended assessment, and if the objection is disallowed, escalate to the Administrative Review Tribunal (ART) — which replaced the former Administrative Appeals Tribunal (AAT) on 14 October 2024. There are strict time limits (typically 60 days for objections), so act quickly.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between an ATO review and a full audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ATO review is a narrower check of specific items (often data-matching), while a full audit examines a broader area in depth. Most matters start as a review and escalate only if issues are found. Engaging an agent at the review stage often prevents escalation to a full audit.

mainEntity.name: Can an agent negotiate an ATO payment plan for audit debt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If an audit results in tax debt, a registered agent can negotiate a payment plan, request remission of penalties and interest where grounds exist, and stop enforcement actions like garnishee orders or director penalty notices.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can I get an ATO-audit-experienced agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance if your ATO matter is time-sensitive.

mainEntity.name: Will engaging an agent make the ATO suspicious?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Using a registered tax agent is entirely normal and expected — it signals you are taking the matter seriously. The ATO deals with agents every day and generally prefers correspondence through a registered representative.
